title: Ned and the Wet Air
note: b414 — Phase 4 (Learning) — consonant clusters sl, sm, sn, sp.

pages.brief: Ned the duckling lifting his head, nostrils flaring, sensing something in the air.
Ned the duckling sniffing the air, dark clouds visible in the distance.
Small cloth bits pegged along a washing rail strung between two posts.
Ned the duckling hurrying toward the washing rail.
Ned the duckling catching himself on the grass, careful not to slip.
Ned the duckling unpegging the cloth bits quickly from the rail.
Ned the duckling grabbing the last few bits in a hurry.
Ned the duckling arriving safely under cover just as the first drops begin to fall.
Ned the duckling standing dry under cover, rain now falling outside.
